## Risks

1. **PDF text extraction not available via fs tool** — References extracted using known literature connections verified through arxiv_search title queries, rather than direct PDF text parsing. All resolved references were verified via arxiv_search against their paper titles.
2. **21 references remain unresolved** — These are primarily self-defined benchmarks, evaluation methodologies, and conference-only publications that do not have arXiv IDs.
3. **Seed papers from 2023–2025 only** — Backward expansion reaches 2016 (GCN) and 2017 (Transformer), but earlier cocitation theory (pre-2000) is not captured. This is acceptable because the survey automation field is post-2020.
4. **Forward expansion is non-exhaustive** — Only papers directly found through arxiv_search title matching are included; there may be additional citing papers not captured.
